segments.text: Understanding Dimensions: How They Shape Our Perception and Reality

In the astral world, a person’s position is determined by his dimension . When someone is born, the dimension he was in at the time of his last death shapes his birth chart. This influences his looks, health, wealth, and even how much negativity affects him.

Think of dimensions as floors in a building and chakras as the steps to reach them. According to Gurutattva , we all have 7 chakras in our body. Once we activate these, we must cross 7 more chakras to reach the 1st dimension , making it 14 chakras in total . To enter the 2nd dimension , we need to go beyond 32 chakras above the 1st.
In simple terms, dimensions act as a bridge between past and future lives, influencing our journey across lifetimes.
Let’s use an example to understand how dimensions act as a shield and protect us.
Imagine a family where two members are at different dimensional levels —one at a higher dimension and the other at a lower dimension .
Now, suppose someone casts black magic on the family. Who will be affected more?

Think of it like this: Imagine a storm hitting a tall building. The person at a higher dimension is like someone on the top floors —they feel the wind, but they are mostly safe. On the other hand, the person at a lower dimension is like someone on the ground floor , directly exposed to the storm’s full force.

Similarly, the one at a higher dimension has stronger energy protection , so they experience fewer negative effects. But the one at a lower dimension, with weaker energy , will feel the full impact of the black magic.
This is why spiritual growth and higher dimensions help in shielding against negative forces!
The Connection Between Bhakti and Dimensions: A Path to Spiritual Ascension
Everyone has a dimension , whether they are a devotee ( bhakt ) or not.

Take the example of Parikshit Bhaiya —he suffered from continuous black magic , which even pulled him into a negative dimension . But despite being in that dark state, his devotion and love for Gurutattva became his greatest strength. Because of his faith, he gained the siddhis (spiritual powers) of the 33 tantriks who were casting black magic on him.

Even in a negative dimension, Gurutattva guided him , teaching him about the astral world, dimensions, and how to fight against black magic . With this knowledge and strength, he eventually overcame the effects of black magic and, in turn, rapidly elevated his dimension .
This shows that bhakti (devotion) is not limited by dimension —no matter where a person stands, true faith can uplift and transform them!
Why Must We Keep Fighting to Maintain and Elevate Our Dimension?
The Continuous Battle to Stay in a Higher Dimension

Reaching a higher dimension is like climbing a tall mountain . But here’s the catch— if you stop climbing, you don’t just stay there… you start slipping down . In the same way, if a person reaches a higher dimension but stops making efforts to grow or sustain it, they will fall back to a lower dimension over time.
Why Does This Happen?

Higher dimensions are not empty, they are already occupied by subtle entities . These entities don’t easily allow newcomers to stay or rise further. They will try to push a person down —just like in a competitive race where stronger players try to eliminate weaker ones . Here, the concept of “survival of the fittest” applies, but in an astral sense —only those who are spiritually strong can hold their position or move up.
Example to Understand This

Imagine a person who works hard and becomes the CEO of a big company . But once he gets there, he stop working, stop learning, and stop making decisions. What will happen? his competitors and jealous colleagues will work against him, making sure he loses his position. Eventually, he will be removed and replaced by someone else.
The same happens in higher dimensions . If someone stops making an effort, other subtle energies will ensure they fall to a lower level.
Are Deities Involved in This?

No. Dimensions are only for humans. Deities have already transcended this cycle. If a deity is said to have a dimension, that means they were once a human like us and went through the same struggles before reaching their divine state.

Only humans can affect the dimensions of other humans. Deities do not interfere in reducing or increasing a person’s dimension. It’s a battle among humans, driven by jealousy, grudges, and competition.
The Lesson

To stay in a higher dimension and move even further, continuous effort is necessary . Stopping means falling. Spiritual strength, awareness, and constant self-improvement are the keys to maintaining and upgrading one’s dimension!
